node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal source-subfield dichotomy
node.closure: exhaustive source-line-lift versus biquadratic-cover split, reciprocal coefficient normal form, and exact low-genus V4 passports
node.statement: For an actual diagonal-order-two component, the diagonal automorphism sends the quadratic source intermediate field K(X) either to itself or to a distinct quadratic intermediate field. In the first case it descends to a source-line involution; geometrically b=-X, s=1/X, psi=X^2, tau=1/Z, and the bidegree-(2,4) source equation lies in an 8- or 7-dimensional reciprocal eigenspace. In the second case the quartic W-projection is a V4 cover; tame Riemann-Hurwitz forces source genus 0 with passport eta,eta',mu or genus 1 with passport eta,eta,eta',eta'. Neither branch is deleted.
